milestones.title: Authorizing official's decision on gather-host claims recorded

remediation: The signing host re-derives every fact it can from the bytes; only publish time, provenance and publisher come from the gather host unsigned. Your organization's authorizing official accepts this, or a second independent source for those facts is added.
title: Facts only the connected gather host can see (publish time, provenance, publisher) reach the signing host as unsigned claims
